name: Hand-in-Middle
summary: Two-handed box selection: the box's centre follows the non-dominant hand, and moving the dominant hand towards or away from it shrinks or grows the box.
howItWorks: The centre of a 3D selection box is attached to the non-dominant hand, which sets its position and orientation; no part of the box is attached to the dominant hand, whose distance from the other hand scales the box. All three techniques shape a 3D selection box with two tracked handheld devices; everything inside the box is selected with the SELECT button. Designed for splat-based volumetric data on a desktop monitor.
